note: Trivial glue submodule of image_styles_generator. No command/route/config/permission/plugin of its own. A ServiceProvider (ImageStylesGeneratorWebpServiceProvider::alter) rewrites the parent's image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer service to class DerivativeWebpWarmer and injects @webp.webp; that subclass calls the parent to build a derivative then Webp::createWebpCopy() to write a .webp copy. Introspection reads the live service class; execution warms a real file and checks the .webp lands on disk. Requires the contrib webp module.

evals.prompt: What does the image_styles_generator_webp submodule add on top of image_styles_generator, and does it introduce its own Drush command?
evals.expected_output: It makes the parent's warm command (drush image:derive:multiple) also write a .webp copy of each derivative. It adds no new command; it overrides the parent's derivative_warmer service so existing invocations produce WebP copies.

evals.prompt: Technically, how does image_styles_generator_webp change the parent module's behaviour? Name the mechanism and the class involved.
evals.expected_output: Its ImageStylesGeneratorWebpServiceProvider::alter() rewrites the image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer service definition to class DerivativeWebpWarmer and adds the @webp.webp argument; the subclass calls the parent then Webp::createWebpCopy().

evals.prompt: Which modules must be installed for image_styles_generator_webp to work?
evals.expected_output: It depends on both the parent image_styles_generator module and the contrib webp module (which provides the webp.webp service). Both are hard dependencies in its info.yml.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the container and state which PHP class the image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer service currently resolves to.
evals.expected_output: It resolves to Drupal\image_styles_generator_webp\DerivativeWebpWarmer, because the enabled submodule's service provider altered the definition. Check with drush php:eval 'print get_class(\Drupal::service("image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer"));'.

evals.prompt: This site has the image_styles_generator_webp submodule enabled, an image style isg_webp, and a published image public://isg_wsrc.png with no derivative generated yet. Warm the image-style derivatives so that a WebP copy of the isg_webp derivative of that file is written to disk.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush image:derive:multiple` (optionally --image-styles=isg_webp). With the submodule enabled the warmer writes both the derivative and public://styles/isg_webp/public/isg_wsrc.webp.
